layout: The meme consists of three panels arranged vertically. Each panel contains characters on the left, a speech bubble in the middle, and large text on the right.
character_position: Characters are located on the left side of each panel, occupying approximately 40% of the space. They are depicted in a marching or lined-up formation.

text_style.color: Black text on a white background.
text_style.position: Speech bubble text is at the top center. The larger text is on the right side of each panel.

content_structure: The meme uses a progression format. The first two panels set up anticipation ('WAIT FOR IT...'), followed by an unexpected twist in the third panel ('LAUNCH!').
description: This meme humorously portrays how waiting for perfect conditions can lead to unexpected and often unfavorable outcomes. It highlights a common scenario in decision-making where anticipated ideal conditions are suddenly replaced by adverse ones.
